all.src: IV rank < 30 and a catalyst or breakout setup inside the expiry.
Open for a net CREDIT; reject debit fills.
Max loss ((K2 - K1) x 100 - credit) <= 1.5% of equity per unit.
All three strikes: OI >= 500, per-leg spread <= max($0.05, 10% of mid).

management.src: Close at 100% of max-loss amount in profit on the upside.
Close at 14 DTE regardless of P/L - the valley between K1 and K3 deepens sharply into expiry.
Stop at 60% of theoretical max loss.

exits.src: ASSIGNMENT GUARD: 1 short call at K1, the deepest ITM strike in the structure. Flatten by 15:45 ET on expiration day, unconditionally.
ASSIGNMENT GUARD: close immediately if the K1 short call is ITM with extrinsic < $0.10 - which is the normal state of an ITM short call in this structure.
DIVIDEND GUARD: close before every ex-dividend date whenever K1 is ITM; an ITM short call with low extrinsic is assigned on the day before ex-div with high probability.
